# vyos.blueprints.nat

Source and destination NAT

- Configures source NAT (masquerade, SNAT, exclusions such as traffic into a VPN) and destination NAT (port forwarding).
- Rules use the rule format of vyos.vyos.vyos_nat (id, description, protocol, exclude, outbound_interface / inbound_interface, source, destination, translation, ...), passed through unchanged, so every option of the module is available.
- For a simple small-office edge, `vyos.blueprints.edge_nat` is shorter.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.nat
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nat_source_rules` | list |  | `[]` | Source NAT rules in vyos_nat format, e.g. `{id: 20, outbound_interface: {name: eth0}, translation: {address: masquerade}}`. |
| `nat_destination_rules` | list |  | `[]` | Destination NAT rules in vyos_nat format. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every rule is installed.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nat_source_rules` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
| `nat_destination_rules` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
